legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is assignable by the Assignee, and any such assignment shall be binding upon the Seller.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Assignee against any and all claims, damages, or expenses arising from the breach of any representation, warranty, or covenant made by the Assignor.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for ensuring that all closing obligations are met, including the payment of all closing costs and fees.
